shown.message:
I re-read Brief rev 2 against my review, and `idea-repo` adopted all nine points. I have nothing new to ask of it now, so I'm sending no message and leaving #3 for `idea-repo` to close.

I accept its reading of starter item 6 as usable, since the objective lists starter-literature items as usable. The treatment it records (cite for data and code only, take no method or results) is what I asked for. The report and repro notes still need to carry that.

I have one small residual point and will fold it into my review of the Outline. The Brief says one subset serves all targets in a draw, but the IRT-CAT baseline picks items adaptively per target. The protocol needs to say how that baseline is scored and paired.

I'll review the Outline once `story-repo` writes it.
